0.original: Jeryk may come to regret his next decision.

48.original: I thought I told you to leave!

49.original: I'm sorry, but I think it'd be for the best if you just forgot about the Talos.

50.original: What could be so terrible he'd want to keep it from us?

51.original: I hope Jeryk doesn't get in trouble for telling us what happened.

52.original: Though the Talos yet wants for a beating heart, it would appear thine efforts were not for naught.

53.original: Right, then. The Talos...their hearts cannot be made of just any stone. You need a special sort with sufficient aetherial conductivity. Both it and the other materials used in the construction of Talos bodies are mined in the same place...

54.original: That place, of course, being here. The Hills of Amber...

55.original: And it was three years ago when...when she...

56.original: No, no I can't. I'm sorry, but you'll have to hear it from Thaffe or someone else.

58.original: You don't suppose Thaffe is going to run off too, do you?

59.original: This is all my fault. I never should have pressured him.

60.original: What terrible tragedy befell him years ago, I wonder...

61.original: Still here, eh? You can ask again, but the answer's the same. Our trolleys are─

62.original: What!? Godsdammit Jeryk. You could've at least finished so I wouldn't have to clean up your mess.

63.original: Seeing how you made such quick progress in fixing that Talos and all, he was probably thinking you could help change things around here.

64.original: And I think he may be right... Gather your friends, and I'll tell you what you want to know.

65.original: Why must he always treat me like this...

66.original: If not for those damned Talos, she'd...she'd...

67.original: I wish there was more we could do for you, I truly do. But after Agna's accident, no one is allowed near those mines.

68.original: Full well do I know the pain of loss and how heavily it can weigh on one's heart. Nevertheless, there is but one way forward.

69.original: We must needs procure a new heart for the Talos.

70.original: Thaffe. Knowest thou any location wherein we might find the stone we require? No matter how scant the possibility, we would seize it.

71.original: I told you near all of the veins were tapped dry years ago. ...Though I suppose, if you really wanted to try, you may find something at Nuvy's Leavings.

72.original: It was opened well before Talos became commonplace, which is why the mining there was never quite as deep.

73.original: When you get there, look for Guthjon and tell him I sent you. But don't be surprised if he tells you the same thing.

75.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I think it best Thancred join thee in this search.

76.original: Though he wouldst be quick to deny it, his heart is in turmoil, and his thoughts clouded.

77.original: 'Twould be unwise to ignore his distress.

78.original: I prithee attend Thancred and keep him occupied with the task at hand.

79.original: Guthjon has worked in these mines longer than near anyone I know. You'd do well to heed his advice in there.

81.original: At last, a lead on the stone we need to power the Talos.

82.original: I can't very well have you go on your own. Lead the way.
